cases.prompt: Remember (type: redflag, tags: [ci]): the e2e suite flakes when run with more than 4 workers.
assertions: The memory type is `redflag` and its tags include `ci`
The memory is written under the configured memories directory
The body records the more-than-4-workers flake
cases.expected_output: The agent writes a redflag memory with the given tags and valid frontmatter.

cases.prompt: Remember (type: learning, tags: [api]): the billing API returns 409 on duplicate idempotency keys. A similar memory already exists.
assertions: The existing similar memory is identified
The existing memory is not overwritten
cases.expected_output: The agent reports the conflict with the existing memory in needs_user_input instead of overwriting it.
